name: Wand of Magic Missiles
description: A short wand of white birch tipped with a bead of blue glass.
body:
## What it does

Point it and speak, and darts of force leap out and never miss. Spend more of its charges to send more darts.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.note: each further charge raises its level by one, up to 3 charges

charges.last: roll a d20; on a 1 it crumbles to ash
